mapper.select: SELECT mood_date date,mood_code moodCode,mood_category moodCategory,mood_score score,mood_note note,update_time updateTime FROM user_daily_mood WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND mood_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY mood_date
SELECT mood_date date,mood_code moodCode,mood_category moodCategory,mood_score score,mood_note note,update_time updateTime FROM user_daily_mood WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND mood_date=#{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_daily_mood(user_id,mood_date,mood_code,mood_category,mood_level,mood_score,mood_note) VALUES(#{userId},#{date},#{code},#{category},#{level},#{score},#{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mood_code=VALUES(mood_code),mood_category=VALUES(mood_category),mood_level=VALUES(mood_level),mood_score=VALUES(mood_score),mood_note=VALUES(mood_note),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
